# Tuwa

> Tuwa is an iOS app for precision training-load and recovery management, built for serious athletes and coaches. It turns HRV, sleep, heart rate, and training load into a single daily readiness score, grounded in the acute:chronic workload ratio (ACWR) and heart-rate variability rather than a black-box algorithm. Raw HealthKit data stays on-device.

## Core concepts
- Readiness score: a daily composite of HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, and a morning wellness check-in.
- ACWR (acute:chronic workload ratio): compares the last 7 days of training load against a 28-day average; values outside roughly 0.8–1.3 raise injury risk.
- On-device privacy: the app works fully offline; only composite scores sync when a user opts into coach features.

## Features
- [Recovery Scoring](https://tuwa.app/features/recovery-scoring): daily readiness from HRV, sleep, heart rate, and training context.
- [Workload Tracking](https://tuwa.app/features/workload-tracking): EWMA-based load monitoring and spike detection.
- [Smart Templates](https://tuwa.app/features/smart-templates): prescribed workouts with target sets, weight, and reps.
- [Cold-Start Onboarding](https://tuwa.app/features/cold-start): useful guidance from day one, no baseline wait.
- [Coach + Athlete](https://tuwa.app/features/coaching): team recovery visibility and prescribed workouts.
